In-memory byte cursor (reader) and byte assembler (writer).

Mirrors the subset of symphonia-core/src/io/{mod,buf_reader}.rs needed for Phase 1/2: exact-width little/big-endian primitive reads with underrun errors (ekDecode), plus a little-endian writer used by the WAV muxer. Buffered/streaming I/O over files arrives with the Ogg/MP4 demuxers (Phase 5+).

Imports

errors

Types

BitReader = object
  data*: seq[uint8]
  bytePos*: int
  bitPos*: int
MSB-first bit cursor over immutable bytes (FLAC subframes). 
BitWriter = object
  buf*: seq[uint8]
  acc*: uint8
  nbits*: int
MSB-first bit assembler (FLAC frame encoder). 
LtrBitReader = object
  data*: seq[uint8]
  pos*: int
  cache*: uint64
  left*: int
MSB-first cached bit reader (MPEG layers). Bits are kept top-aligned in cache; left counts valid bits from the top. 
Reader = object
  data*: seq[uint8]
  pos*: int
Cursor over an immutable byte buffer. 
RtlBitReader = object
  data*: seq[uint8]
  pos*: int
  cache*: uint64
  left*: int
LSB-first bit reader (Vorbis): bit 0 read first is the LSB. 
VlcEntry = object
  case kind*: VlcEntryKind
  of veJump:
    target*: int
  of veValue:
    value*: uint32
    codeLen*: int
VlcEntryKind = enum
  veJump, veValue
VlcTable = object
  table*: seq[VlcEntry]
  maxCodeLen*: int
  bitsPerBlock*: int
Writer = object
  buf*: seq[uint8]
Growable byte buffer with LE/BE primitive writers.
